baseline_models.focus_anchor: The governing يعلم opens four ما-clauses paired as يلج/يخرج at الأرض and ينزل/يعرج at السماء.
baseline_models.mechanism: Opposed imperfect verbs organize knowledge around continuous boundary crossings: inward and outward below, downward and upward above. The object of knowledge is therefore dynamic traffic as well as entities.

activation_trace.role: Knowing as disclosure supplies the governing awareness under which every crossing is manifest.
Entry into another's interior supplies the inward half of the terrestrial pair.
Passage to the outside supplies the outward half of the terrestrial pair.
Descent and arrival supply the downward heavenly channel.
Rising upward supplies the reciprocal heavenly channel.

changed_reading.before: He knows all things in heaven and earth.
changed_reading.after: He knows every ongoing crossing of the earth and sky boundaries, including what is still in transit.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The four traffic clauses close with وهو الرحيم الغفور rather than with a bare knowledge formula.
baseline_models.mechanism: Mercy and protective forgiveness qualify exhaustive knowledge: nothing is missed, yet complete exposure is framed by care and shielding from consequences rather than by surveillance alone.

activation_trace.role: Full disclosure supplies the potentially exposing side of the mechanism.
Tender mercy turns comprehensive awareness toward beneficent care.
Covering sin and protecting its bearer supplies a protective outcome for what knowledge exposes.

changed_reading.before: Merciful and Forgiving are detachable epithets after a statement of omniscience.
changed_reading.after: The knower of every exposed passage is simultaneously the one who treats the known with mercy and protective forgiveness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The fourfold traffic becomes an exact account: even a dispersed minute particle cannot pass out of awareness, its case is established in a record, and that precision serves recompense. Forgiveness is therefore not divine oversight but a known and purposive response.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure anchors the model in the focus assertion of knowledge.
Distance, absence, and escape are explicitly denied, closing any route out of awareness.
Minute size and dispersal stress that even scattered micro-traffic remains tracked.
Written establishment that entails judgment converts observation into an accountable record.
Matching action with recompense supplies the record's ethical function.

structural_cues: 34:3 repeats heavens and earth, spans smaller and larger, and ends with a clear book.
The purpose clause at 34:4 immediately directs exhaustive knowledge toward recompense, forgiveness, and provision.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies non-escape, dispersed minuteness, established writing, and recompense; I infer an arrow from tracked crossings to exact moral accounting. A live alternative is that 34:3 only intensifies omniscience without making the four focus verbs ledger-like.

changed_reading.before: The verse depicts broad cosmic awareness.
changed_reading.after: Every crossing, down to dispersed particulate movement, enters a precise account from which just recompense and informed forgiveness proceed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's descending channel acquires semantic cargo: what is sent down can be knowledge-bearing truth that enters a human recipient and redirects movement onto a path.

activation_trace.role: Literal descent anchors the changed reading in what descends from the sky.
Sending something down and delivering it supplies revelation as the cargo of descent.
Gentle direction toward the true path supplies the delivered content's downstream effect.

structural_cues: 34:6 identifies what was sent down as truth and coordinates it with guidance to a path.
The recipients are those given knowledge, linking descent to human recognition rather than only to weather.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sending down, truth, knowledge, and guidance; I infer a channel from heavenly delivery to human orientation. The alternative is to keep 34:2's descent materially general and treat revelation as only one later instance.

changed_reading.before: What descends from the sky is an unspecified physical flow.
changed_reading.after: The downward flow also includes truth-bearing communication whose arrival produces knowledge and guidance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earth and sky are not passive containers. Torn bodies can be re-created after terrestrial dispersal, earth can engulf, and detached sky matter can be made to fall; the paired channels are sovereign, reversible, and potentially catastrophic.

activation_trace.role: Entry into an interior anchors engulfment and burial in the focus's inward channel.
Passage outward anchors renewed emergence from terrestrial dispersal.
Descent anchors the threatening inversion in which sky matter falls.
Tearing into separated pieces supplies the body's extreme dispersed condition.
Bringing creation into existence supplies emergence beyond fragmentation.
Earth's sinking or engulfing activates the terrestrial inward channel as judgment.
Downward falling activates the heavenly channel as imposed motion.
A detached piece of sky specifies the threatening cargo of descent.

structural_cues: 34:7 juxtaposes total bodily tearing with new creation.
34:9 offers paired threats from the same earth/sky frame used by the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fragmentation, new creation, engulfment, and falling sky pieces; I infer burial-to-emergence and sky-to-earth reversal as realizations of the focus channels. The alternative is to restrict the focus to ordinary natural traffic and treat these as separate power signs.

changed_reading.before: The four movements describe a stable cosmic circulation.
changed_reading.after: They are reversible sovereign boundaries through which life can be dispersed and restored, or protection can turn into engulfment and impact.

context_deltas.mechanism: The packet directly reactivates the focus inventory's earth/termite branch. Hidden creeping penetrates and consumes a load-bearing staff; the delayed outward collapse then discloses that the jinn did not know the unseen. Divine knowledge includes subvisible ingress, internal attrition, and the eventual visible consequence.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure anchors the contrast between divine knowing and creatures' failed knowledge of the hidden.
The packet's termite image lies latent in the focus word for earth and supplies the surprising lexical hinge.
Hidden creeping supplies the nearly imperceptible initiating process.
The creature of earth explicitly activates the focus inventory's wood-eating termite image.
Internal consumption and corrosion supply the gradual loss of support.
Noisy unstable falling supplies the delayed external result of hidden ingress.
Manifestation after concealment turns material collapse into epistemic disclosure.

structural_cues: 34:14 sequences death, an unnoticed earth-creature, eating, collapse, disclosure, and the jinn's ignorance of the unseen.
The staff remains apparently stable while its interior support is being consumed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hidden creeping, the earth/termite branch, consumption, collapse, and disclosure; I infer a causal arrow from unnoticed penetration to delayed visible failure. The live alternative is that the earth label is merely taxonomic and the focus's ingress/egress pair should not be extended into the staff.

changed_reading.before: Knowledge covers large, readily named movements between cosmic regions.
changed_reading.after: Knowledge also follows minute hidden penetration inside matter and already comprehends the collapse that will eventually make that process visible.

context_deltas.mechanism: Descent, terrestrial reception, vegetal emergence, and consumption form a provision circuit. Gratitude is imaged by fresh growth showing outward, while a retaining structure's failed or released flood reverses the circuit and substitutes degraded produce.

activation_trace.role: Descent anchors the incoming water side of the ecological circuit.
Emergence anchors growth and yield coming outward from earth.
Rain descending as provision links heavenly input to edible yield.
Fresh shoots coming out make gratitude materially legible as fruitful emergence.
A retaining embankment supplies regulation of the descending and flowing medium.
One yield replacing another supplies the circuit's punitive reversal.

structural_cues: 34:15 places two gardens, eating, provision, gratitude, a good land, and a forgiving Lord in one scene.
34:16 reverses that scene through a flood and replacement gardens with inferior yield.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies provision, gardens, gratitude, a flood-retaining structure, and substituted produce; I infer the hydrological arrow from descent through soil to growth and food. The alternative is a moral-historical contrast with no need to model the focus verbs as one ecology.

changed_reading.before: The verse lists independent movements known by God.
changed_reading.after: The movements can be read as one regulated ecology in which heavenly input becomes terrestrial fruit, and the same route can be reversed into loss.

context_deltas.mechanism: Ascent is not an automatically open route. Intercession joins one party to another only by permission, and speech follows the removal of fear from inner hearts; upward communication is licensed and affectively prepared.

activation_trace.role: Rising upward anchors the model in the focus's ascending channel.
Disclosure anchors divine access to the inner states involved in communication.
A mediator joining another supplies the relational traffic seeking access.
Permission supplies the gate condition for that traffic.
Removal of fear supplies the transition that precedes intelligible exchange.
The heart supplies the concealed affective interior known before speech emerges.

structural_cues: 34:23 sequences restricted intercession, permission, fear removed from hearts, and question-and-answer.
The sequence closes with divine height, keeping the communication spatially oriented.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mediation, permission, inner fear, speech, and height; I infer a controlled upward communication channel corresponding to يعرج. A live alternative is that 34:23 describes court protocol without specifying the direction of ascent in 34:2.

changed_reading.before: Whatever ascends does so through an undifferentiated open path.
changed_reading.after: At least one class of upward traffic is permissioned: inner states are settled and access is granted before speech reaches the high court.

context_deltas.mechanism: The inward/outward pair gains an affective and social analogue: remorse is hidden internally, then judgment takes visible bodily form as collars fixed around necks. Knowledge spans the concealed state and its externalized consequence.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure anchors knowledge of both hidden motive and manifest result.
Entry into an interior supplies the focus-side analogue for inwardly held remorse.
Bringing a hidden thing out supplies the focus-side analogue for externalization.
Hiding something in the interior specifies remorse's concealed phase.
Grief over what has passed supplies the content held inward.
A collar binding the limb supplies the visible imposed consequence.
The neck locates that consequence on the exterior body.

structural_cues: 34:33 places concealed remorse immediately before visible collars on necks.
The same ayah traces covert night-and-day pressure, hidden response, and public recompense.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealed remorse followed by bodily restraint; I infer an inward-to-outward disclosure pattern analogous to يلج/يخرج. The alternative is simple juxtaposition: the chains punish deeds but do not externalize the hidden affect.

changed_reading.before: Entry and exit concern only physical traffic through earth.
changed_reading.after: The pair can also organize divine knowledge of what enters concealment within persons and what judgment later brings into manifest form.

context_deltas.mechanism: Provision is expanded or narrowed, wealth exits in expenditure, and a successor is supplied in its place. The focus traffic becomes an economy of circulation and replacement rather than a static measure of possession.

activation_trace.role: Outward passage anchors expenditure as a meaningful outflow.
Merciful care anchors the provision cycle as beneficent rather than mechanically compensatory.
Increase and abundance supply the expansion phase of provision.
Narrowing to a small measure supplies the contraction phase.
Wealth leaving through expenditure supplies deliberate human outflow.
One thing succeeding and standing in for another supplies replacement after outflow.
Apportioned giving supplies the source and renewed inflow of the cycle.

structural_cues: 34:36 and 34:39 repeat the same expansion/constriction formula.
34:39 then appends a direct expenditure-to-replacement relation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies expansion, constriction, expenditure, replacement, and apportioned giving; I infer a circulation arrow from received provision through outflow to renewed provision. The alternative is that replacement is a promise detached from the physical traffic of 34:2.

changed_reading.before: Known inflows and outflows are cosmological facts.
changed_reading.after: They also disclose a provision economy in which possession is temporary flow, generous outflow is known, and replacement remains under divine allocation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah contrasts truth projected from knowledge of the unseen with humans projecting claims at the unseen from afar. Hidden revelation and near hearing provide the authorized channel; the focus's descent/ascent pair thus acquires an epistemic distinction between delivered signal and remote guess.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure anchors the valid signal in comprehensive divine knowledge.
Delivery downward anchors communicated content entering the world.
Forceful casting supplies truth's directed transmission from the knower of hidden things.
Secret imparting of knowledge specifies the authorized hidden signal.
Understanding and compliance make near hearing the reception side of the signal.
Throwing words supplies the counterfeit human projection toward the unseen from a distance.

structural_cues: 34:48 coordinates casting truth with intensive knowledge of hidden things.
34:50 names revelation, hearing, and nearness; 34:53 repeats casting but marks its source as distant from the unseen.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divine truth-casting, secret impartation, near hearing, and distant human word-casting; I infer authorized and counterfeit directions within the focus's traffic. The alternative is a rhetorical contrast about truth and false claim with no spatial channel model.

changed_reading.before: Descent and ascent carry unspecified objects.
changed_reading.after: They can carry epistemic signals whose reliability depends on source, authorization, and proximity: revelation arrives from knowledge, while distant guessing only projects at the hidden.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ending closes the mobility assumed by the focus: there is no escape, seizure occurs from nearby, reaching from afar fails, and a barrier is inserted. Ingress, egress, and ascent are governed opportunities rather than permanently open routes, giving present forgiveness temporal urgency.

activation_trace.role: An entry place or hidden passage anchors the focus as a system of traversable routes.
Outward passage anchors the possibility that the route of escape can be denied.
Protective forgiveness anchors the still-open present alternative to terminal closure.
Failure of reaching or escaping closes the outward route.
Capture and restraint supply the enforced endpoint of failed escape.
Extending to reach something supplies the access attempt made impossible by distance.
A separating barrier supplies final closure between persons and their desired object.

structural_cues: 34:51-54 moves from no escape, to seizure nearby, to failed reaching from afar, to a barrier between parties and desire.
The sequence is temporal as well as spatial: the attempted belief comes after prior rejection.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed escape, capture, inaccessible reaching, and an inserted barrier; I infer that the focus routes are governed apertures that can close. The alternative is to confine closure to the final judgment scene and leave 34:2's movements perpetually descriptive.

changed_reading.before: The cosmic routes appear continuously and neutrally open.
changed_reading.after: Their openness is governed and time-sensitive: the knower can permit passage, deny escape, and finally interpose a barrier, so the title Forgiving names an opportunity not to postpone.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's split س م و to و س م mapping rather than the ordinary sky branch. It remains anchored in السماء, the focus inventory's sign branch for علم, and the surah's fresh-growth cue; downstream prose should present it only as a packet-licensed resonance, not as a replacement gloss for السماء.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يعلم and السماء, read through the supplied mark/sign and rain-marking branches.

activation_trace.role: A distinguishing mark that guides to its object turns knowledge into legible indication.
First rain marking earth with vegetation supplies descent as an inscribing action.
Soft productive earth supplies the receiving surface on which the mark emerges.
Fresh shoots emerging supply the visible trace left by received provision.

changed_reading.before: Divine knowledge is invisible cognition of rain and growth.
changed_reading.after: What descends can make that knowledge outwardly legible: rain marks receptive earth with emerging vegetation as a sign.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because it activates the packet's س م م target under س م و and its narrow-hole branch. It remains spatially anchored by يلج, السماء, يعرج, and the later permission gate; prose must label it an aperture analogy and must not claim that السماء lexically means a hole here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يلج, السماء, and يعرج together permit a controlled-aperture model of vertical passage.

activation_trace.role: An entry place or narrow refuge supplies the general architecture of passage.
A narrow opening through which something enters supplies the surprising sky-as-aperture image.
Ascent supplies the traffic directed through that imagined aperture.
Permission supplies contextual support for controlled rather than automatic access.

changed_reading.before: Sky is an undifferentiated open expanse through which things move.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the sky boundary behaves like a controlled aperture: vertical traffic passes through openings whose access is permissioned.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because it joins the literal womb branch of رحيم to the earth's ingress and egress. It remains focus-only and visibly anchored in the paired verbs, productive earth, womb, and protective covering; downstream prose should qualify it as a material analogy for hidden formation, not assert that every terrestrial passage is birth.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ما يلج في الأرض وما يخرج منها beside الرحيم الغفور.

activation_trace.role: Entry into an interior supplies reception into a hidden formative space.
Soft productive earth supplies a medium capable of holding and growing what enters.
Emergence to the outside supplies the completion of hidden formation.
The female womb supplies the contained-growth analogy latent in الرحيم's root inventory.
Protective covering supplies the shelter around what forms unseen.

changed_reading.before: Earth merely receives and releases already constituted things.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, earth's inward and outward traffic can resemble gestation: entry is held under covering mercy until hidden formation emerges.

strongest_changes: The four verbs became process knowledge of boundary crossings rather than a static inventory.
34:3-4 turned microscopic traffic into exact, recompense-bearing account without reducing forgiveness to oversight.
34:14 activated the packet's earth/termite branch and exposed a hidden-ingress-to-visible-collapse mechanism.
Provision, revelation, intercession, and final closure showed that the same routes can nourish, communicate, gate, reverse, or close.
summary.what_was_special: The packet produced unusually exact cross-links: أرض's wood-eating termite branch is enacted at 34:14, while split س م و inventories support carefully contained readings of rain as a visible mark and sky as a controlled aperture.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the four movements are a comprehensive merism or four distinct channels with separate mechanics.
How far later communication and judgment sequences may spatialize يعرج rather than merely analogize it.
The split-root marking-rain and aperture readings remain packet-licensed but form-distant and should stay explicitly exploratory.
The gestational model is coherent across focus branches but lacks a direct contextual trigger.
